title: The Bio-Age Dawns on the Judiciary -- Ch. 6: Veracious and Venerable Magistrate
link: The Bio-Age Dawns on the Judiciary (book)
primary_topics: Chapter 6: CJP's opening remarks honoring the retirement of Justice Vicente V. Mendoza, and the renovation of the Supreme Court Session Hall he oversaw
sub_topics: Reopening of the refurbished Session Hall (April 1, 2003) as part of Mendoza's legacy
Tribute to Justice Vicente V. Mendoza as a 'veracious and venerable' magistrate
Setting the theme, tone, and cadence of the commemorative program

stances.claim: Justice Mendoza exemplifies the veracity and venerability the magistracy demands.

notable_anecdotes: The refurbished Session Hall reopened on April 1, 2003 as part of Justice Mendoza's legacy to the Court.
one_paragraph_summary: Chapter 6, 'Veracious and Venerable Magistrate,' is CJP's opening remarks honoring the retirement of Justice Vicente V. Mendoza. He welcomes guests to the newly refurbished Supreme Court Session Hall (reopened April 1, 2003) — part of Mendoza's legacy — and pays tribute to the honoree as an exemplar of the veracity and venerability the magistracy demands.
